To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PTEN expression level decreases before neuronal apoptosis and PTEN expression level increases after okadaic acid-induced apoptosis.
serum withdrawal induces a continuous decrease both in mRNA and protein level of PTEN phosphoprotein.
serum deprivation and potassium deprivation induce the decrease in PTEN mRNA and protein expression in Neuro-2A cells and cerebellar granular neurons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of PTEn in neuronal apoptosis.
the regulation of PTEN expression by apoptotic signals and its possible role in the regulation of neuronal apoptosis.
the regulation of PTEN expression by different apoptotic inducers and the relationship between PTEN expression level, apoptotic changes, and phosphoinositide-3-kinase/Akt signaling pathway.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the regulation of PTEN expression level in neuronal apoptosis depends on cell type, apoptotic inducer, and the duration of treatment.
the regulation of PTEN mRNA expression in neuronal cells is complex and depends on the apoptotic stimulus.
PTEN is a tumor suppressive gene and that it is involved in neuronal apoptosis, but its role in neuronal apoptosis is not clear yet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PTEN phosphatases are regulated at the transcription level by some apoptotic inducers, and that PTEN phosphates regulate the apoptotic signal transduction pathways involving PI3-kinase/Akt.
PTEN expression is regulated in neuronal apoptosis, but it does not seem to be an essential factor for apoptosis.

PTEN phosphatases expression level and neuronal cell apoptosis are not related in general but the changes in PTEn phosphatase expression level seem to regulate certain apoptogenic signals affecting the function of phosphoinositide-3-kinase.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PTEN expression level can be regulated by apoptotic signals and that the PTEN phosphatases can regulate the function of certain apoptotic signals.
PTEN expression is regulated at the level of gene expression and that this expression can be affected by apoptotic inducers.
PTEN phosphatases are important players in the apoptotic signaling pathways in neuronal cells.
